basis: Primary lymphatic drainage failure causes chronic dermal/subcutaneous swelling and fibrosis. Secondary infection risk does not establish immune involvement.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: lymphatic vessels are not explicitly covered by the cardiovascular axis; blood-vessel or cardiac disease is not established.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: the defining chronic edema and tissue fibrosis affect skin and subcutis.

basis: Amyloid cardiomyopathy; neuropathy and gastrointestinal dysmotility each annotated 30-79%. Pulmonary/hepatic congestion is secondary; renal involvement is 5-29%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: supplied HPO annotations place amyloid-associated gastrointestinal dysmotility and chronic diarrhea at 30-79%, supporting common functional involvement.

basis: Adrenal aldosterone excess and electrolyte disturbance define the disease. Associated hypertension is a separately diagnosed condition.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: hypertension is common but separately diagnosed; common direct cardiac or vascular damage independent of hypertension is not established.

basis: Inherited axonal peripheral neuropathy; denervation atrophy and foot deformities follow nerve injury rather than direct muscle or bone disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: common muscle wasting and foot deformities are consequences of denervation; direct skeletal muscle or bone pathology is not established.

basis: Carcinoma originates in the soft palate, an oral structure. Oropharyngeal classification alone does not establish additional airway involvement.

decisions.pulmonary: none: the specified origin is the soft palate of the mouth; the broader oropharyngeal parent does not establish a second affected organ axis.

basis: Cartilage stippling and skeletal dysplasia define this umbrella. Ichthyosis and intellectual disability vary by subtype and are not established across most patients.

decisions.dermatologic: none: despite the broad definition mentioning ichthyosis, skin disease is subtype-dependent and does not characterize most patients across the umbrella.

basis: Immune enteropathy/endocrinopathy; chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis 80-99%, dermatitis 30-79%. Cap excludes bronchiectasis, bladder dysfunction, bone loss, cytopenias and vascular lesions.

decisions.pulmonary: none under cap: bronchiectasis occurs in 30-79%, but the three defining axes and more frequent chronic skin involvement fill the four-axis limit.
decisions.dermatologic: involved: chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis occurs in 80-99% and eczematoid dermatitis in 30-79%; these support persistent skin disease.

basis: Inherited proximal tubulopathy with defining phosphate wasting and hypophosphatemia; rickets, osteomalacia, osteopenia and recurrent fractures reported in 2/2 patients.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: persistent electrolyte and phosphate disturbances are defining features of this inherited tubular transport disorder, supporting the metabolic mechanism axis.

basis: Hair abnormalities and developmental impairment define the disorder. Esodeviation and abnormal ocular pursuit in 1/2 do not establish direct eye damage.

decisions.ocular: none: esodeviation and jerky pursuit occur in 1/2, but ocular motor findings can reflect neurologic dysfunction without direct ocular tissue damage.

basis: SURF1 respiratory-chain disease with characteristic encephalopathy; regression 13/13, optic atrophy 2/2. COX-negative fibers alone do not establish myopathy; respiratory failure may be central.

decisions.neurologic: primary: progressive encephalopathy characterizes SURF1 disease; developmental regression in 13/13 and ataxia in 11/11 support a defining neurologic phenotype.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: COX-negative fibers in 15/15 demonstrate enzyme deficiency, but do not establish functional myopathy; hypotonia in 11/11 can arise from encephalopathy.
